entries.name: 明清实学
entries.recognitionCue: Complete large foreground waterwheel, canal and bridge, craftspeople and fields, surveying/learning activities and pragmatic figures on the hill path, densely inhabited river town, Chinese pavilions and layered mountains. Preserve the practical study/action relationship and all instruments; no newly inserted table-of-scholars foreground.

entries.name: 乾嘉朴学
entries.recognitionCue: Full desk-level book/manuscript collation and stacks in the foreground pavilion, scholars inspecting textual and material evidence, miniature town and wide river panorama, roof lines, bridge, boats and distant mountains. Preserve little instruments/page comparison rather than replacing with large calligraphy labels. Keep original restrained wood/stone/gray-blue sunlight palette.

entries.name: 拉丁美洲哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Modern Latin American city square and street with public conversation, coffee tables, books/newspapers, mural walls and banners naturally integrated into urban architecture. Keep distinct contemporary people, purposeful public discussion, civic plaza, central modern buildings and original perspective. Paint modern clothing/faces/material as fine restrained oil, cinematic muted urban light; no ancient Greek transplant, giant heroic portrait or fake slogan. Preserve existing small wall text as visual texture.
